subject: Polaris: evaluation sprint plan + marketplace billing lifecycle
messages:
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@polarishealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Peter Martin <peter.martin@polarishealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Polaris: looking for a clear eval & billing flow for Marketplace private offers

Evelyn / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team here is excited by the latency and cost profile you showed. Procurement asked me to pull together a short mutual action plan that ties the evaluation sprint to how we expect billing to flow through Azure Marketplace (Polaris requires marketplace invoicing for SaaS purchases).

High level asks from our side:
- A 7-business-day technical evaluation (sandbox) with predefined success criteria (latency under 200ms p95, inference cost estimate).
- Clear acceptance gate that ties to our security checklist (SOC2 + on-prem data handling questions).
- Marketplace private offer that invoices to our PO #PH-2028-7789 — legal will need DocuSign for the PO/offer.

Can you send a MAP with owners, dates, and the billing routing options (Azure private offer vs. direct invoice) so I can get procurement and finance aligned? If there’s a recommended path that minimizes paperwork, call that out.

Also copying Peter (procurement) — Peter, can your team accept an Azure marketplace invoice or do you need Redwood to invoice directly?

Best,
Samantha
Procurement Lead, Polaris Health

--
S. Wu
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@polarishealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Peter Martin <peter.martin@polarishealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris: looking for a clear eval & billing flow for Marketplace private offers

Samantha — thanks for the clear summary. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (POLARIS_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW so legal can see scope and acceptance gates. High level proposed flow below; spreadsheet has the owners/dates:

Proposed condensed MAP (summary):
1) Kickoff & sandbox access — Jun 23 (Jordan lead)
2) 7-business-day eval — Jun 24–Jul 2 (Karthik support)
3) Technical acceptance sign-off — Jul 3 (Polaris + Redwood)
4) DocuSign private-offer & PO routing — Jul 3–10 (Marissa + Polaris legal)
5) Production activation on Azure private offer — target Jul 12

Billing options (pros/cons):
- Azure Private Offer (recommended): Invoice flows through Azure marketplace to Polaris PO; pros: clean procurement record, simplifies tax/compliance. Cons: private-offer setup takes ~3–5 business days and requires DocuSign acceptance.
- Direct Redwood invoice: Faster to start but requires Polaris procurement to accept vendor invoice; may need additional finance approvals.

I’ll set up a 30-minute kickoff to lock dates — Jordan, Karthik, Marissa: can you confirm availability next Tue (Jun 23) morning?

Attachments: POLARIS_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_Polaris_draft_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@polarishealth.com>, Peter Martin <peter.martin@polarishealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris: looking for a clear eval & billing flow for Marketplace private offers

Adding a few technical acceptance details so they can be plugged into the MAP spreadsheet:

Acceptance criteria (technical):
- Baseline: run the standard Polaris sample workload (provided in sandbox) at target seq len; p95 latency <= 200ms for 8k tokens; throughput target 20 concurrent sessions.
- Cost estimate: provide per-1k-token estimate for both hosted (Redwood API) and private-offer (dedicated capacity) runs.
- Security: KV cache not persisted to disk; TLS enforced; customer IAM for private VPC access if needed.
- Logs: provide a limited audit-log export for the 7-day eval window (masked PII).

Notes on marketplace SKUs: Azure private offers can map to a metered SKU (we can create a test meter for the eval period). For GCP private catalog we can do a similar metered test but Polaris noted preference for Azure, so I’ll focus there unless you ask otherwise.

I’ll fill the technical column in POLARIS_MAP_v1.xlsx and drop a short checklist for the sandbox run.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@polarishealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Peter Martin <peter.martin@polarishealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris: looking for a clear eval & billing flow for Marketplace private offers

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement/legal: 

- Polaris requires the invoice to be generated via Azure Marketplace for any purchases of third-party SaaS tied to our PO process. We can accept a private-offer invoice to PO PH-2028-7789.
- Legal will only sign the private-offer if the offer includes the standard data processing addendum (we can attach our template).
- DocuSign is required for the private-offer acceptance; our legal lead wants to see the exact offer URL in the DocuSign envelope.

Operationally, we’d like the 7-business-day eval to start the day sandbox access is granted and for Redwood to provide a short post-eval report (sample load, latency, and estimated monthly cost at projected utilization).

I’ll plan to attend the kickoff on Jun 23 AM — Peter will advise on legacy PO constraints but we can likely accept marketplace invoice routing.

Samantha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@polarishealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Peter Martin <peter.martin@polarishealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris: looking for a clear eval & billing flow for Marketplace private offers

Samantha / team — quick legal note to keep the rollout smooth: 

1) DocuSign envelope should include: (a) the Azure private-offer acceptance page link, (b) Redwood’s Master Services Addendum, (c) Polaris DPA template (if requested). Please mark the DocuSign with the HUBSPOT deal id so finance can reconcile.
2) Billing path: if Polaris wants Azure marketplace invoicing, we’ll create the private offer and select marketplace-managed billing. That will generate a marketplace invoice that Polaris can apply to PH-2028-7789.
3) Timeline dependency: we need the signed private-offer DocuSign before we can enable production SKU mapping in the marketplace — sandbox access can be done earlier but production activation is gated on the signed offer.

I’ll prepare a one-page acceptance checklist we can tie to the MAP (list of deliverables to trigger sign-off). Evelyn — please loop me into the DocuSign review so we can expedite.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@polarishealth.com>, Peter Martin <peter.martin@polarishealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris: looking for a clear eval & billing flow for Marketplace private offers — final MAP and next steps

Team — updating with the finalized MAP and owners attached (POLARIS_MAP_v1.xlsx revised). Summary and next steps: 

- Kickoff: Jun 23, 10:00am PT (30m) — Jordan to send calendar invite.
- Sandbox access granted: Jun 24 morning — Karthik will post credentials to the shared secure folder.
- Eval window: Jun 24–Jul 2 (7 business days). Post-eval report due Jul 3.
- DocuSign private-offer envelope created: Marissa to prepare and share by Jun 24; envelope id: ENVELOPE-54XY (link in related_links).
- Acceptance gate: Polaris sign-off on post-eval report + security checklist to trigger private-offer acceptance.

Attachments: POLARIS_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW_Polaris_draft_v2.pdf

Samantha / Peter — please confirm that the kickoff time works and that your legal team will be ready to review the DocuSign envelope the day it’s posted. If marketplace invoicing is accepted, finance will reconcile via HubSpot deal 987654321.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting Polaris live.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
